method: Opened official product, pricing, billing and policy pages with the web tool. No purchases, logins, account provisioning or performance measurements.

sources.evidence: Traffic uses decimal GB. Region tiers accumulate monthly; settlement is hourly. Introductory packages expire after 30 days. Request, upstream transfer and logging charges are distinct.
Public product page confirms global footprint and live/recorded media delivery. Numeric network claims are publisher claims, not measurements.

sources.evidence: Published USD prices use GiB/TiB. Destination tiers apply per project. Misses can add backend processing, and requests sent to external origins incur internet egress charges.
The first five global forwarding rules share a $0.025/hour charge per project. Additional rules cost $0.01/hour each. Regional and global rules are charged independently.
$300 introductory credit expires after 90 days. Eligibility requires no previous paid Google Cloud/Maps/Firebase use and no earlier trial. The recurring free product list does not include Cloud CDN.
Cloud CDN is integrated with the global external or classic Application Load Balancer. Global Front End Enterprise also offers unified pricing; displayed rates cover standalone CDN pricing.
video/* is an explicitly supported cacheable MIME type subject to normal cacheability requirements.
Media CDN is recommended for large streaming workloads. Cloud CDN and Media CDN do not deliver RTMP or WebRTC directly.

corrections: Made the price label region-specific and retained binary units.
Added an actual hourly forwarding-rule charge and trial expiry.
Confirmed video caching while distinguishing the separate Media CDN product.
limitations: Displayed fee components are not a full account quote; backend processing, Cloud Armor, logging and external-origin charges depend on setup.
No capacity number is asserted, and no ISP routing measurement was performed.

sections: Data transfer from origin to Front Door
sources.evidence: Base fee accrues per profile per whole or partial deployed hour, with no extra endpoint fee. Front Door does not meter origin-to-edge traffic; non-Azure origins may charge egress independently.
New Azure customers can use a single $200 credit across Azure services for 30 days. This is not an ongoing Front Door allowance.
Region-specific official inventory lists Seoul and gives a current total of 192 edge locations in 109 metros.

limitations: Rate card calls its unit GB. The reviewed Front Door pages do not define GB in bytes; no decimal/binary conversion is inferred.
